verdict.rationale: Shopify POS is a SaaS retail platform that ships an AI assistant (Sidekick), so an AI-training data opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting, policy, or control that keeps merchant data out of AI model training. The Sidekick mentions describe AI features only, not data-use controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
